finding: A tallest-row plus anti-diagonal column shortcut fits both demos but changes the first query. Column widths are ignored.
program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((div-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) 3)))
                              r))
                  (div-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) 3)))
                              c))
                  (row-bounds (append (list -1) div-rows (list h)))
                  (col-bounds (append (list -1) div-cols (list w)))
                  (row-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs row-bounds))
                                           (if (null? (cdr bs))
                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)
                                                           (- (cadr bs) 1))
                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))
                  (col-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs col-bounds))
                                           (if (null? (cdr bs))
                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)
                                                           (- (cadr bs) 1))
                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))
                  (nr (length row-ranges))
                  (nc (length col-ranges))
                  (regions (for*/list ((ri (range 0 nr)) (ci (range 0 nc)))
                             (let ((rr (list-ref row-ranges ri))
                                   (cr (list-ref col-ranges ci)))
                               (list (* (+ 1 (- (second rr) (first rr)))
                                        (+ 1 (- (second cr) (first cr)))) ri ci))))
                  (selected (argmax first regions))
                  (pr (second selected))
                  (pc (third selected))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((ri (range 0 nr)))
               (for ((ci (range 0 nc)))
                 (let* ((rr (list-ref row-ranges ri))
                        (cr (list-ref col-ranges ci))
                        (clr (cond
                               ((and (= ri pr) (= ci pc)) 7)
                               ((or (= ri pr) (= ci pc)) 0)
                               ((and (< ri pr) (< ci pc)) 2)
                               ((and (< ri pr) (> ci pc)) 4)
                               ((and (> ri pr) (< ci pc)) 1)
                               (else 8))))
                   (for* ((r (range (first rr) (+ (second rr) 1))) (c (range (first cr) (+ (second cr) 1))))
                         (hash-set! result (list r c) clr)))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
